item.title: Daily Minute — November 10, 2026
item.description:
The ego looks straight at the Father and does not see Him, for it has denied His Son.
Would YOU remember the Father? Accept His Son and you WILL remember Him. Nothing can demonstrate that His Son is unworthy, for nothing can prove that a lie is true. What you see of His Son through the eyes of the ego is a demonstration that His Son does not exist, yet where the Son is the Father MUST be. Accept

item.title: Lesson 131: “No-one can fail who asks to reach the truth.”
